final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC ISO 8601 format with "Z" suffix, extracted the message after the service name, and captured the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. I also summed the repeat counts from any following repeated message lines. Finally, I aggregated the counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the requested JSON structure following Acme log-triage conventions.
